setting.title: Optimus-3: Dual-Router Aligned Mixture-of-Experts Agent with Dual-Granularity Reasoning-Aware Policy Optimization
setting.environment: MineRL (20 Hz control), agent spawned with EMPTY inventory at randomized biome/position
setting.runs_per_task: at least 30 rollouts per task from different initial positions (Table III); group SR reported with standard deviation
setting.benchmark: the 67-task Long-Horizon benchmark is INHERITED UNCHANGED from Optimus-1 (arXiv:2408.03615) -- Optimus-3 does not redefine or re-list it: Wooden(10), Stone(9), Iron(16), Gold(6), Diamond(7), Redstone(6), Armor(13) = 67 (vs our 70 -- count mismatches in Wooden/Stone/Gold, same as noted for the Optimus-1 paper itself)
setting.controller: Optimus-3 is an end-to-end MoE model (Qwen2.5-VL backbone, 6.8B params, Task Router + Layer Router) -- no separate low-level policy like STEVE-1; baselines that use an MLLM-as-planner (GPT-3.5/GPT-4o/Qwen2.5-VL/Qwen2.5-VL-SFT/Gemini-1.5-pro) pair that planner with STEVE-1 as the policy
setting.memory: Optimus-3 itself does NOT use a memory-retrieval module (departs from Optimus-1/JARVIS-1's memory-augmented approach in favor of MoE routing); memory is only relevant to the JARVIS-1 and Optimus-1 baselines being compared against
setting.notes: Table III gives GROUP-LEVEL SR+-SD only for the 67-task Long-Horizon benchmark -- no per-task numbers and no appendix (this paper has no appendix; all content is in Tables I-V and Figs 1-12). Table IV gives genuine PER-TASK numbers (CR and SR) but for a separate, small, 5-task 'open-ended' natural-language-instruction benchmark with a live inventory -- do NOT conflate Table IV SR with Table III's tech-tree group SR; they are different experiments/protocols entirely. All values parsed directly from HTML <table> DOM (not an LLM summarization pass), cross-checked against the abstract's claimed deltas -- high confidence in exact figures.
